was: Adds one capture listener for `reset` on the control's shadow root when it is inside one, else on control.ownerDocument; returns a no-op observer when the document has no addEventListener.
now: Adds one capture listener for `reset` on the control's root (control.getRootNode(), else the owner document): the document, the shadow root when the control is inside one, or, for a tree that is not connected yet, that tree's root together with the owner document (one event is handled once). Returns a no-op observer when the root cannot listen.
why: Found while building: a control observed before its form is connected (packages/core/test/field-value.test.ts does so) never hears a listener on the document, because the reset event of a detached form does not reach it.
